policy: A resolution is only applied to a HotSpawn fixture that the freshest automated board leaves with no pick. The board's own market line always wins if one exists.

Every number is either copied from a quoted price (with the two decimal odds recorded verbatim) or recomputed from the official Valve VRS table published by ValveSoftware/counter-strike_regional_standings. Nothing is inferred.
HotSpawn's crowd pick percentage is never read and never enters a probability.

The research ladder for an un-priced fixture is HLTV -> esportsbooks / betting lines -> prediction-market (Polymarket) -> official Valve VRS origination. Each step is recorded with the URL, the read time and what it answered, including failures.
